That works well for the hero's trust strip, but it's really a 3-badge display (Trustpilot/HostAdvice/Google), not a per-testimonial star rating, so it doesn't obviously fit replacing the individual review card stars — I need to reconsider what the instruction actually intends for that third usage.

I'm leaning toward replacing the hero trust strip and the reviews-section header StarRow with the real ReviewBadges component, since those act as aggregate trust signals — while leaving the per-testimonial star ratings inside individual quote cards untouched, since those are part of the testimonial layout rather than a Trustpilot-style summary and swapping them would be structural rather than cosmetic polish.

I want to check how ReviewBadges is used elsewhere across the site to understand the established convention before deciding on the replacement pattern.
